falseSynonyms.zh: accident 通常強調非故意。 incident 更中性，不一定是意外。

falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A human error caused the accident.

falseSynonyms.zh: collision 著重兩物相撞。 crash 常帶較強烈、嚴重的交通事故感。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The two cars had a minor collision. The high-speed crash caused serious injuries.

falseSynonyms.zh: slip 是失去抓地力。 fall 是身體真正倒下或墜落。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She slipped on the wet floor but did not fall.

falseSynonyms.zh: spill 通常是液體被意外倒出或散出。 leak 通常是從裂縫、管道或容器中慢慢逸出。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON He spilled the coffee. The pipe leaked water overnight.

falseSynonyms.zh: 設備可以發生 malfunction 而沒有造成任何事故。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The sensor malfunctioned, but no accident occurred.

falseSynonyms.zh: near miss 指差點發生事故，但最終沒有造成碰撞或傷害。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The cars almost collided, but it was a near miss rather than an accident.

falseSynonyms.zh: injury 是傷害結果。 accident 是造成傷害的事件。
